The name "Daggoo" itself is introduced in the same paragraph's opening sentence. No orphaned name.

5. **Pip introduction** — "Black Little Pip—he never did—oh, no! he went before." Pip has not been introduced anywhere in the preceding draft chapters. 7. **"They called him King-Post on board the Pequod; because, in form, he could be likened to the short, square timber known by that name in Arctic whalers."** — Source adds "and which by the means of many radiating side timbers inserted into it, serves to brace the ship against the icy concussions of those battering seas."
